source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/OAM_0 (OAM_0 chassis data (siblings OAM_1..7 analogous)) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "Chassis - OAM_0~7". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES uses a read-only chassis query, but validates only OAM_0, assumes seven siblings are analogous, exposes credentials, bypasses TLS verification and selects only three identity fields.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires actual Chassis enumeration, vendor OAM topology, complete per-member fields, sensitive-value redaction and WebUI correlation.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 948/2291 accepts the one-member command as direct execution and does not test whether OAM_0 through OAM_7 exist, map uniquely or are complete.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The preceding audited EROT record is a security-firmware identity; the following RETIMER_0~7 records are firmware-inventory/topology objects. Neither proves the OAM chassis population.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No draft for this source identity was found in invalidated runs.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 overlay exists for this exact case.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the eight-index title and WebUI method; ED-34 permits a bounded API override; ED-35 prevents one OAM_0 read from being credited as OAM_0~7 coverage; ED-36 treats the topology/spec matrix as readiness input.

original_test_intent: Verify every Project-supported OAM chassis instance named by OAM_0 through OAM_7 is present as expected and that its complete Inventory and LEDs detail is readable and correct for the mapped physical slot.
original_method: Enumerate the actual Chassis collection, resolve every supported OAM member and absent slot from the approved topology, collect full read-only member details, correlate each with the source WebUI view, and compare identity, health/state, power and links to the Project matrix without fabricating resource names.
manual_activity: The platform owner must define the fitted OAM population, physical-slot/resource mapping, absent-slot behavior and expected fields. Collection and comparison can then be automated, with operator review only for UI presentation or ambiguous platform mapping.
required_inputs: OAM meaning, fitted count and OAM_0~7 topology
Actual Chassis schema/member map and pagination
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or invoke chassis power, reset, firmware or hardware actions.
Do not assume `/Chassis/OAM_0` or synthesize OAM_1 through OAM_7; enumerate the collection and prove the mapping.
Do not use insecure TLS or command-line credentials as the formal method.
Do not expose full serial or asset identifiers; preserve stable redacted correlation.
Treat absent, unfitted, unsupported, duplicate and failed member reads distinctly; one valid OAM_0 response cannot complete eight-index coverage.
Stop on ambiguous slot mapping or cross-SUT identity rather than guessing.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the target, collection/schema, protected access, OAM topology and expected matrix.
Enumerate all Chassis members and select OAM instances from authoritative mapping.
Capture complete redacted per-member identity, status/health/state, power and relationship links.
Compare all expected present/absent slots and correlate the WebUI detail view.
Archive raw and normalized evidence and return facts without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the fitted OAM_0~7 population and slot/resource mapping.
Approve required fields, absent-slot semantics and WebUI/API coverage equivalence.
Review every per-slot result and assign the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The OAM_0 GET is a partial probe only. It neither enumerates the collection nor validates OAM_1~7, status, power, links, UI parity or exact physical mapping, and it uses insecure access.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the protected paginated Chassis collection, map actual members to the approved OAM_0~7 topology and collect every required field per member before WebUI comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OAM_0~7 scope, Inventory and LEDs WebUI path, readable/correct Criterion, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates are preserved; the owner decides expected fitted slots.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use complete collection-driven per-OAM inventory with physical-slot mapping and WebUI/API parity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected platform's OAM chassis inventory model.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build and Redfish Chassis schema.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor OAM topology/inventory specification and Project configuration recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete member enumeration, per-slot mapping, full fields, protected access and absent-slot handling while retaining WebUI validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OAM_0 alone is one-eighth or less of stated coverage; API evidence does not prove the WebUI display unless equivalence is accepted.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: OAM population/topology, field baseline, schema and redaction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mis-mapped resources or silently absent slots can yield a false complete inventory; serial data is sensitive.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish collector may replace or supplement the WebUI only with recorded original/actual methods, engineer approval, per-field/per-slot equivalence and uncovered display/navigation coverage. The missing OAM map is readiness pending, not a permanent blocker.
expected_evidence: Target and firmware/WebUI identity, trusted session, complete Chassis collection and timestamps
Approved OAM_0~7 fitted/absent and physical-slot/resource map
Raw redacted and normalized complete record for every actual OAM member
Per-slot identity/status/health/power/link comparison with explicit missing or duplicate results
WebUI correlation or override coverage, preserved logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items explicitly defines OAM_0~7 and the Procedure/Criteria consistently request chassis detail correctness. The one-member DeepSeek shortcut is a review defect, not a conflict inside the preserved Master row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The multi-member OAM inventory purpose is clear. Platform topology and expected population are Project readiness inputs that can be supplied without changing the Master source.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects extrapolation from OAM_0 and adds complete collection, mapping and secure evidence requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with its hybrid classification and topology-driven approach while explicitly preserving the eight-index coverage boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Corrects direct-run acceptance of a one-member, three-field probe.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates OAM chassis objects from EROT and retimer firmware identities.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid record exists for this identity.

review_improvement: Makes every OAM slot independently traceable, distinguishes unfitted from failed inventory, protects sensitive IDs and prevents a single convenient resource from masquerading as full OAM_0~7 coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish member IDs are vendor-defined and need not be consecutive or equal physical OAM indices. A correct review must discover actual members, bind them to an approved topology, and account for all eight named positions or documented absences; otherwise a healthy OAM_0 response says nothing about OAM_1~7 completeness.
